name: overhead
status: sim2real refit; replaces the ChArUco-derived optical pose in config.overhead_camera
frame: config.overhead_camera.pos/xyaxes are relative to the overhead_stand body (MuJoCo camera axes: x right, y up, looks along -z)
method: Lens position fixed from a side photo of the stand: about 2.4 cm in front of the column face, on the column centreline, about 2 cm below the column top (world x 0.004, y 0.116, z 0.540 after a 0.5 cm settle).

Rotation fitted by maximizing IoU between the real dark-arm silhouette and the sim arm segmentation over 14 static poses (so101_rl/sim2real_capture.py, run 20261126-211901), arm pose from the measured joints with the wrist-roll correction (run_real.SIM_MINUS_REAL_DEG).
notes: The ChArUco result placed the camera 4.6 cm from the shoulder-pan axis sideways; the physical lens is about 11.6 cm from it (on the stand centreline). The board-to-follower offset assumed by that calibration (205 mm forward, 20 mm left) is the likely error; it was not re-measured.
Intrinsics (K, D) are unchanged; the visible PCB/lens proxy geoms are unchanged and already agree with the photo.
Policies and datasets rendered with the replaced pose see a different overhead view; retrain or fine-tune.
